responsibility: Primary interface and data-structure header for C++ name lookup. It defines binding objects, module-aware binding vectors and clusters, lookup mode enums, and declarations for the routines that manipulate scopes, push/pop declarations and namespaces, perform qualified/unqualified lookup, manage using directives, and traverse module binding state in the C++ front end.
same_name_distinction: Defines the core binding data structures, lookup-mode enums, macros, and function declarations used by the C++ name-lookup subsystem. Unlike name-lookup.cc, it does not perform lookup itself; it specifies the representation and callable interface for that subsystem.
